KherveAI_Notes.recap_summary: The user conducted a comprehensive XPS analysis of a strontium titanate (SrTiO₃) sample with surface contamination. The survey identified four elements (O, Ti, Sr, C) consistent with a perovskite oxide, and detailed fitting of individual core levels confirmed the primary phase as SrTiO₃ with secondary SrCO₃ surface carbonate and adventitious carbon contamination. The C1s spectrum showed typical adventitious carbon (C-C dominant with minor C-O), while O1s, Sr3d, and Ti2p spectra all exhibited excellent data quality and fitted well to the expected SrTiO₃ + SrCO₃ model. One minor concern flagged was an inconsistent binding energy shift for the SrCO₃ component in the Sr3d spectrum, which could indicate charging effects or possible misidentification of the surface species.
